name: @bancada/desktop
description: Bancada desktop app: Electron main process and React renderer.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --composite false && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json --composite false
scripts.e2e: pnpm --filter @bancada/pty-host build && electron-vite build --ignoreConfigWarning && playwright test
scripts.bench: pnpm --filter @bancada/pty-host build && pnpm --filter @bancada/replay build && electron-vite build --ignoreConfigWarning && playwright test -c playwright.bench.config.ts
